annotations.title: Check adaptive components (adaptation points, host placement, linked parameters, regenerated geometry) declared as data of a scene (indicative)

description: Appelez quand vous devez VERIFIER DES COMPOSANTS ADAPTATIFS (points d adaptation qui regenerent la forme) : points d adaptation (AC-POINTS), placement/hote (AC-HOTE), parametres lies (AC-PARAMETRES), geometrie regeneree (AC-GEOMETRIE). scene : composants_adaptatifs [{points, hote, parametres, geometrie}] (alias adaptive_components). Indicatif — composant pilote par regles, pas le modelage adaptatif interactif de Revit ; la decision reste humaine. Lecture seule.
